notes.title: April 2023 Update
notes.content:
The game update brings some amazing gameplay improvements. First, we fixed several bugs that were reported by our players, including the issue of the item disappearing when picked up and the bug preventing the completion of an important quest.
and a few more notes.
In addition to the facilitated system of locomotion.
We've also added new enemy variations, which means you'll have to face new challenges and develop new strategies to defeat them. Keep an eye out for enemies that move faster and attack in different ways to avoid being caught off guard!

Additionally, we've made tweaks to enemy AI, making them smarter and more unpredictable. You'll need to be more attentive and quick in your moves to win!

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs and suggested improvements. If you encounter any problems while playing the game, please don't hesitate to contact us. We are always working to make the game experience as good as possible for our players.
